classes.label: Tomato_Bacterial_spot
classes.recommended_action: Copper-based bactericide sprays; avoid overhead irrigation; isolate symptomatic plants; sanitize pruning shears.

classes.label: Tomato_Early_blight
classes.recommended_action: Apply preventive fungicide (chlorothalonil or copper); remove lower diseased leaves; improve airflow and mulch soil.

classes.label: Tomato_Late_blight
classes.recommended_action: Immediate removal and destruction of infected foliage; apply targeted late blight fungicide; check neighboring plants daily.

classes.label: Tomato_Leaf_Mold
classes.recommended_action: Reduce greenhouse humidity below 85%; increase row ventilation; apply registered fungicide if symptoms spread.

classes.label: Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot
classes.recommended_action: Remove lower infected foliage; avoid watering from above; apply appropriate protectant fungicide.

classes.label: Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_mite
classes.recommended_action: Apply insecticidal soap or horticultural oil; release predatory mites (Phytoseiidae); reduce dust and heat stress.

classes.label: Tomato__Target_Spot
classes.recommended_action: Ensure proper spacing for air circulation; avoid leaf wetness; apply protective fungicides during warm humid weather.

classes.label: Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus
classes.recommended_action: Control whitefly vectors using yellow sticky traps and fine mesh netting; remove and bag infected plants immediately.

classes.label: Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus
classes.recommended_action: Remove and incinerate infected plants; wash hands and tools thoroughly with milk or TSP; avoid handling tobacco products near crop.

classes.label: Tomato_healthy
classes.recommended_action: Crop shows no dominant visual symptoms of disease. Maintain standard irrigation schedule and routine monitoring.
